title: DecisionRequest
description: One decision the system asks of a person or a decider: the question, its options, the recommendation and its grounds, who may decide, and the decision once taken.

question_key.description: <case>|<action>|<question id or empty>: the same question asked again has the same key; a prior decision is looked up by it.

subject_revision.description: Its revision under decision; the decision applies to this revision only.

subject_path.description: The file to read, relative to the case's work/.

autonomy_level.description: The run's level when the request was opened.

holder.description: Who decides: the class's cell at the run's level, after per-run overrides (docs/autonomy-levels.md:297-320). The guards read it.

eligible.description: The principals who may decide, handed in by the host; a listed person may decide whatever the holder (lowering is always allowed, docs/autonomy-levels.md:311).

addressed_to.description: The principal whose inbox holds the request: the eligible person first asked, or the one it was escalated to.

expires_at.description: When silence ends the request: it is decided with the recommended default, or expires.

recommended_answer.description: A free answer recommended in place of an option, for a question request only.

default_on_silence.description: Whether silence until expires_at takes the recommended option or answer.

grounding_report.description: The grounding check's one-line report on the recommendation it verified.

no_recommendation_reason.description: Why the request carries no recommendation: the grounding check's refusals.

decided_answer.description: The free answer decided in place of an option, for a question request only; it is written to questions.yaml as the answer, as an option's consequence.answer is.

produced_record.description: The Canon record the decision produced, set by RecordProduced after the runtime wrote it; absent on a Decided request means the Canon write has not been recorded yet and the run does not resume.

sdc.decision.ActionId.title: ActionId
sdc.decision.ActionId.description: A protocol action id, such as roadmap.approve.

sdc.decision.ArtifactId.title: ArtifactId
sdc.decision.ArtifactId.description: A case artifact id (canon-case/1 artifacts key), such as roadmap.

case.description: The case whose snapshot holds the artifact; absent means the request's case.

entry.description: One entry of the artifact, for artifact goals: the entry id (product/p1). The ground rests on that entry: it must exist in the current goals layers, apply at the check's instant (inside its validity window, not overridden by a lower layer) and still have the digest. A revision that moved since is noted (revision_moved), not refused (docs/requester.md decision 3).

digest.description: sha256:<hex> of the cited entry as sdc-goals digest prints it; written by the grounding check when absent, so a later check sees a change.

sdc.decision.AutonomyLevel.title: AutonomyLevel
sdc.decision.AutonomyLevel.description: The run's autonomy level, docs/autonomy-levels.md:36-42 and :205-213: A0 Manual, A1 Advised, A2 Internal, A3 To merge, A4 To release, A5 Unattended (eval runs, :41-42). The level does not decide eligibility by itself: with the request's decision class it gives the holder (:241-256, overrides :297-320), and the guards read the holder.

sdc.decision.CapabilityId.title: CapabilityId
sdc.decision.CapabilityId.description: A Canon capability an action requires, such as owner.approve.

sdc.decision.CaseId.title: CaseId
sdc.decision.CaseId.description: A Canon case id (canon-case/1 id), such as IDEA-1.direction.

sdc.decision.Citation.title: Citation
sdc.decision.Citation.description: Where a ground is: path:line, a record id, artifact@revision, or one entry of an artifact (goals@<revision>#<entry id>). A program checks that each resolves (tools/decision-grounds.sh; a goals entry through sdc-goals ground).

sdc.decision.Consequence.title: Consequence
sdc.decision.Consequence.description: What choosing the option does to the protocol.

grant.description: The authority entry the option writes, for an approval.

answer.description: The answer written to questions.yaml, for a question.

produces.description: The kind of Canon record the option produces when decided; absent when it produces none, such as 'leave it untaken' on an outcome request. Only a decided option that produces a record goes through RecordProduced before the run resumes.

sdc.decision.DecisionClass.title: DecisionClass
sdc.decision.DecisionClass.description: The decision classes of docs/autonomy-levels.md:244-257, one row each, named as the keys of sdc.decision-classes/1 (:398-413). In Loom a class is an identifier validated against the host's classes document; budget_overrun and limit_hit are Loom built-ins. escalation names the row that gives a request's holder after Escalate; Request refuses it as a class of a new request.

sdc.decision.DecisionOption.title: DecisionOption
sdc.decision.DecisionOption.description: One option of a decision request.

does.description: What the option does, one sentence.

cost.description: What it costs: work, time, scope or risk.

sdc.decision.DecisionRequestId.title: DecisionRequestId
sdc.decision.DecisionRequestId.description: Id of a decision request, chosen by the driver: DR-<case>-<action or question id>-<n>.

sdc.decision.Ground.title: Ground
sdc.decision.Ground.description: One ground of a recommendation: its source kind, a citation that resolves, the option it supports (or the free answer) and how.

supports.description: The option the ground supports; absent: it supports the recommended free answer.

how.description: How the cited text supports the option, one sentence.

sdc.decision.GroundSource.title: GroundSource
sdc.decision.GroundSource.description: The kind of source a ground cites. idea: the person's own input and its dissection items (work/idea.yaml, work/dissection.yaml), which the decider cites (d1 to d4 in runs/trial-todo-1/decisions.jsonl). goals: one entry of the requester's goals document (sdc.goals/1, docs/requester.md § 2), cited as artifact_revision of artifact goals with its entry id and the entry's digest, displayed goals@<revision>#<entry id>.

sdc.decision.Holder.title: Holder
sdc.decision.Holder.description: Who decides this request, the cell of docs/autonomy-levels.md:242-257 for its class at the run's level (holders :233-239). person: P, a person decides. advised: P+, a person decides with the decider's proposal shown as the recommendation (propose only). decider: D→P, the decider takes any option and an escalate goes to a person. decider_final: D*, an escalate is suppressed and the decider's best is final. rule: R and the cells 'R, then P', a rule decides and an escalate goes to a person. rule_final: the cells 'R: end', a rule decides, an escalate is refused and the run ends. rule_and_decider: R∧D→P, the rule's verdict is recorded as a strong recommendation; the decider takes it (TakeRecommendation) or vetoes, and a veto is an Escalate; it never grants against the rule. rule_and_decider_final: R∧D*, the same, except that a veto is a Decide on the denying option, after which the run ends as refused with no explicitly_abandoned record. Under decider_final and rule_and_decider_final a decider result that is missing, failed or withheld by the grounding check decides the denying option, or ends the run where no option denies, and escalation_suppressed records the cause; a rule verdict withheld under rule_and_decider counts as no recommendation and goes to a person, under rule_and_decider_final the run ends. Override order (docs/autonomy-levels.md § 2.3): person < advised < rule_and_decider < rule, decider (not comparable); each non-final holder < its final variant; rule_and_decider_final < rule_final, decider_final. A move down is a lowering; every other move is a raise and needs the class's admitted ceiling.

sdc.decision.OptionLetter.title: OptionLetter
sdc.decision.OptionLetter.description: The letter of an option: A, B, C, in the order presented.

path.description: A file path relative to the repository root.

digest.description: sha256:<hex> of the cited lines when the ground was checked; a different digest later means the ground changed.

sdc.decision.Principal.title: Principal
sdc.decision.Principal.description: Who decides: a person's name (operator), decider:<kind> (decider:model, decider:approve, decider:reject; decider:haiku in runs before D149), or silence for a default taken because nobody answered. Recorded as given, as Canon records a principal (canon-decisions/1).

sdc.decision.PrincipalKind.title: PrincipalKind
sdc.decision.PrincipalKind.description: person: a named person. decider: decider:<kind>. rule: rule:<name>, a program deciding from evidence (docs/autonomy-levels.md:202-203). silence: the recommended default taken because nobody answered before expires_at (not in autonomy-levels.md; a person-facing addition, A0 to A4 only in practice).

sdc.decision.ProducedDocument.title: ProducedDocument
sdc.decision.ProducedDocument.description: The Canon record a decided request produced. canon_authority: an AuthorityDecision entry bound to the case revision (approval). canon_decisions: an ExplicitDecision entry (outcome). canon_evidence: the approval evidence a manual action produced (context_approval, vision_approval, roadmap_approval). artifact_revision: the new revision of questions.yaml holding the answer (question).

record.description: The record id: the evidence id (canon_evidence), <capability>@<case_revision> (canon_authority), <outcome>/<decision>@<case_revision> (canon_decisions), or artifact@revision (artifact_revision).

aep_record.description: The AEP approval-record id, where one was written.

sdc.decision.ProposerKind.title: ProposerKind
sdc.decision.ProposerKind.description: Who proposed the recommendation: a deterministic rule, an LLM (accepted only when its citations pass the grounding check), a person, or the reuse of a prior decision.

sdc.decision.RecordStore.title: RecordStore
sdc.decision.RecordStore.description: Where a cited record id is looked up: the decision request log, a case's evidence/ (canon-evidence/1 id), authority.json, decisions.json, or an AEP planning store (kind:name).

sdc.decision.Revision.title: Revision
sdc.decision.Revision.description: An artifact or case revision as the case snapshot writes it.

sdc.decision.Strength.title: Strength
sdc.decision.Strength.description: How strongly the grounds support the recommended option. none: the request carries no recommendation (stored before Recommend and after a withheld one; a Recommend sending none is refused). strong: a vision, requirement, PRD, story or spec states it, or a prior decision on the same question and subject stands with its grounds unchanged. moderate: a policy, an autonomy rule or an evidence record supports it by inference. weak: the grounds make it plausible only.

sdc.decision.UnblockKind.title: UnblockKind
sdc.decision.UnblockKind.description: What the decision unblocks. approval: an action that is approval-required, decided by an authority grant. question: an interview question a writer hands off (questions.answer handoff, docs/driver.md:112-114). outcome: a case outcome that requires an explicit decision (canon-decisions/1); its request has two options, the decision (produces canon_decisions) and 'leave it untaken' (produces none).

sdc.decision.Unblocks.title: Unblocks
sdc.decision.Unblocks.description: The case and the protocol action, question or outcome the decision unblocks.

capability.description: The capability whose grant decides an approval.

question_id.description: The question id in questions.yaml, for kind question.
